title: Answer: the papers state no account of free will or agency

statements.text: Chronoflux takes no position on free will or on what agency is, and no paper discusses an agent or a choice. What it says nearby concerns lawful evolution: attained histories have a stable inverse evolution on their image, and in the quantum regime the deterministic density equation yields no single realized outcome, which would need an added fundamental stochastic law.
statements.scope: a reading of the papers cited in this folder, July 2026 and earlier

sources.quote: attained histories possess stable inverse evolution on their image
The deterministic density equation does not by itself produce a realised outcome.
Objective collapse therefore requires a fundamental stochastic law.
